Title: Generally available: Azure Site Recovery update rollup 65 - November 2022

Body.Content:
This update provides the following improvements for the latest version of Azure Site Recovery components. 

  • Mobility Service - added Linux support:

    • Azure to Azure – Debian 11 and SUSE Linux Enterprise 15 SP4. 

    • VMware/Physical to Azure – Debian 11 and SUSE Linux Enterprise 15 SP4. 

  • Microsoft Azure Site Recovery (Portal) 

    • Modernized VMware to Azure DR is now supported for government clouds.  

This update also provides bug fixes. 

Learn more about the issues fixed and get the download links.
